verdict.rationale: Shopify documents extensive public APIs. These include the Admin GraphQL API for driving store operations, the Storefront API for products, carts and checkout, scoped access-token authentication, quarterly versioning, a GraphiQL explorer for running queries and mutations, and official client libraries. Agent-facing MCP and UCP endpoints extend this for AI agents. Community reports criticize API documentation and design and say some API access depends on account type, but they do not show the API is missing. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the API works well, a machine-readable spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), and evidence against the community complaints about plan-gated API access and doc quality.
